title: Lidar Point Cloud Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Lidar_Point_Cloud_Generator.md
text: 为驾驶场景或 RoadRunner Scenario 生成激光雷达点云数据，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；{Unique identifier of sensor} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Required interval between sensor updates (s)} 指定传感器更新之间的必需时间间隔、{Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} 指定激光雷达传感器中心的位置、{Sensor’s height (m)} 指定激光雷达传感器的高度、{Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的偏航角、{Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的俯仰角、{Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的横滚角、{Coordinate system used to report point cloud} 指定报告的检测的坐标系 Ego、{Include ego vehicle in generated point cloud} 指定在点云中包含自车、{ActorID of ego vehicle} 指定自车的 ActorID 值、{Include roads in generated point cloud} 指定在点云中包含道路、{Source of actor profiles} 指定参与者配置文件的来源 From Scenario Reader、{MATLAB or model workspace variable name} 指定参与者配置文件的变量名称、{Maximum detection range (m)} 指定最大检测范围、{Range accuracy (m)} 指定距离测量的精度、{Azimuthal resolution of lidar (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的方位角分辨率、{Elevation resolution of lidar (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的仰角分辨率、{Azimuthal limits of lidar (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的方位角限制、{Elevation limits of lidar (deg)} 指定激光雷达传感器的仰角限制、{Add noise to measurements} 指定向测量添加噪声，按实例取值。

ports.name: Actors
ports.summary: 场景参与者位姿 Simulink bus containing MATLAB ® structure

ports.name: Ego Vehicle
ports.summary: 自车位姿 Simulink bus containing MATLAB structure

ports.name: Point Cloud
ports.summary: 点云数据 m -by- n -by-3 array of positive real-valued [ x, y, z ] points

params.name: Unique identifier of sensor
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Required interval between sensor updates (s)
params.values: 传感器更新之间的必需时间间隔 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器中心的位置 [1.5 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Sensor’s height (m)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的高度 1.6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的偏航角 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的俯仰角 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的横滚角 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Coordinate system used to report point cloud
params.values: 报告的检测的坐标系 Ego Cartesian (default) | Sensor Cartesian

params.name: Include ego vehicle in generated point cloud
params.values: 在点云中包含自车 on (default) | off

params.name: ActorID of ego vehicle
params.values: 自车的 ActorID 值 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Include roads in generated point cloud
params.values: 在点云中包含道路 on (default) | off

params.name: Source of actor profiles
params.values: 参与者配置文件的来源 From Scenario Reader block (default) | From workspace

params.name: MATLAB or model workspace variable name
params.values: 参与者配置文件的变量名称 actor_profiles (default) | valid variable name

params.name: Maximum detection range (m)
params.values: 最大检测范围 120 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Range accuracy (m)
params.values: 距离测量的精度 0.002 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Azimuthal resolution of lidar (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的方位角分辨率 0.16 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Elevation resolution of lidar (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的仰角分辨率 1.25 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Azimuthal limits of lidar (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的方位角限制 [-180 180] (default) | 1-by-2 real-valued vector of form [ min, max ]

params.name: Elevation limits of lidar (deg)
params.values: 激光雷达传感器的仰角限制 [-20 20] (default) | 1-by-2 real-valued vector of form [ min, max ]

params.name: Add noise to measurements
params.values: 向测量添加噪声 on (default) | off
